drivers.name: gams-fitpack-polynomial-values
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent FITPACK consumer with exact scaled monomial references, linear/cubic/quintic interpolating splines, uniform and reversed nonuniform source data, scalar/vector calls, input preservation, repeated new_fit state reset and final destruction. Pinned API and author example reviewed, no upstream code copied. Checks values at 33 targets including boundaries and at original nodes. Positive smoothing, periodic curves, extrapolation, malformed inputs and performance remain unverified.

Positive smoothing, periodic curves, extrapolation, malformed inputs and performance remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-specialmatrices-diagonal-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned API reviewed, no upstream code copied. Nonsingular signed diagonal matrices at three scales, one four-column and four vector RHS solves per fixture, known coordinate answers, scalar residuals, zero RHS, shape/finite checks and input preservation. Other structures and singular solves remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-dynamics-response-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source/author example reviewed, no upstream code copied. Only unit mass and diagonal stiffness are verified, using closed-form complex responses for 1/2/3 uncoupled coordinates, proportional damping and frequency-dependent complex forces. Natural frequencies and callback state checked. Broader nonunit-mass and coupled-unit-mass probes fail at static frequency and are preserved with source hashes/results under docs/gams-candidates/dynamics. No initial-value integration, coupling, arbitrary mass normalization or performance claim.

drivers.name: gams-orderpack-ranking-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source reviewed, no upstream code copied. All permutations through length seven plus six deterministic patterns at fourteen sizes including empty input. Four typed overloads checked against independent insertion-sorted values, valid permutation indices and unchanged inputs. Tie index order, NaN ordering and performance remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-m-la-magic-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source reviewed, no upstream code copied. Orders 1 and 3 through 32 cover odd, doubly-even and singly-even constructions. Repeated compact/padded calls verify finite exact integer entries, permutation 1..n*n, exact row/column/diagonal sums and untouched padding. Order two is excluded because no normal magic square exists. Other utilities and performance remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-maptran-wgs84-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source reviewed, no upstream code copied. WGS84 forward references from ellipsoid geometry; inverse receives independent Cartesian inputs, not library forward results. Both angle units, negative/zero/positive heights, dateline wrapping and exact forward polar-axis references. Inverse poles, origin and custom ellipsoids remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-forlab-least-squares-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source reviewed, no upstream code copied. Shared full-column-rank tall singular-factor fixtures with prescribed unique least-squares solutions and orthogonal residuals. Three vector RHS calls per fixture using native catalog RPRE single precision. Existing unrelated checksum-guarded norm fix reused unchanged. The wide 2-by-3 probe returns nonfinite values; its source/hash/result are retained under docs/gams-candidates/forlab. Underdetermined, square and rank-deficient solves are not verified; no tolerance was relaxed.

drivers.name: gams-nonlin-lsq-jacobian-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer with 24 exact exponential fits and user Jacobians; same exact-fit subset as the checked MINPACK driver. Explicit initial step bound factor 1. Checks Jacobian finite differences, callback use, stopping flags, known parameters, zero objective, returned residuals and stationarity. Default step bound and nonzero-residual probes fail with false convergence; their sources, hashes and results are retained under docs/gams-candidates/nonlin-least-squares. Neither their accuracy criteria nor library code is changed. G1b1a and constrained sibling types remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-fglm-transform-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned API reviewed, no upstream code copied. Double-precision vector addition/component products plus single-precision z-axis rotation and translation composition. Independent double-precision coordinate references, homogeneous points/directions, orthogonality, determinant and input preservation. Other vector overloads, arbitrary 3D axes and performance remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-function-parser-identities
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source/author example reviewed, no upstream code copied. Fourteen common arithmetic identities at twenty input pairs give 280 ordinary references. Explicit error reporting and recovery checked. Parser reuses compiled expressions, preserves variable arrays and checks three parse plus three evaluation errors. No symbolic computation, exhaustive grammar, arbitrary domain behavior or performance claim.

drivers.name: gams-str2real-decimal-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source/author test reviewed, no upstream code copied. Valid decimal/scientific strings checked against arithmetic references and formatted READ, including both signs, E/e, exponent scales and long mantissas. Relative errors tested even for tiny normal values; zero checked separately. This parser does not validate malformed input; malformed, overflowing/underflowing strings and correct rounding remain unverified.

drivers.name: gams-geompack-delaunay-reference
drivers.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
drivers.modifications: Independent API consumer; pinned source/author test reviewed, no upstream code copied. Rectangle hull with deterministic interior points, scales, translations and reversed input order. Checks Euler counts, finite/restored coordinates, all vertices, CCW triangles, duplicate triangles, area, independent incircle determinants, edge incidence, reciprocal neighbors and complete boundary cycle. No particular triangulation chosen for cocircular ambiguity; invalid/degenerate sets and performance remain unverified.
